basis.quote: The monomer geometry is optimized at the B3LYP/def2-TZVPPD level,[63–65] the _π_ - _π_ stacking distance of 4 _._ 72<sup>˚</sup> A is determined by a fragment-constrained dimer geometry optimization at the _r_<sup>2</sup> SCAN-3c level,[66] and the lateral distance of 25 _._ 43<sup>˚</sup> A is determined by a potential energy surface scan using _r_<sup>2</sup> SCAN-3c.[66]

dispersion.quote: The Cy7-DiMePh monomer is optimized using the ORCA 6.0 package at the B3LYP/def2-TZVPPD level with the D4 dispersion correction and an implicit methanol environment.[1–5]

solvation.quote: Both the constrained dimer optimization and the lateral potential energy surface scan S7 are performed in the ORCA 6.0 package using the _r_<sup>2</sup> SCAN-3c method with an implicit water solvent.[4, 5, 8]

software.quote: Both the constrained dimer optimization and the lateral potential energy surface scan S7 are performed in the ORCA 6.0 package using the _r_<sup>2</sup> SCAN-3c method with an implicit water solvent.[4, 5, 8]
